# Gingerbread (G4)

Gingerbread is the *community-labeled* name for a rarely seen, adult male Earth pony in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for a **warm tan coat, rust-red mane and tail, and pale green eyes** in the crowd helping rebuild Sweet Apple Acres' barn. His design resembles Starburst. The [background-stallion catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) lists him at **S3E8, about 18:39**, but flags the name as *dubious*: the show's continuity establishes the pony's presence, not an official name or family relationship.

**Speaking and appearances:** No individually identifiable spoken line, solo singing part, or verified voice-actor credit. His only clearly documented appearance is **“Apple Family Reunion” (season 3, episode 8; December 22, 2012)**, during “Raise This Barn.” He is not visible in the customary Apple-family portraits, so his exact relationship to the family is uncertain; see the [Apple family appearance notes](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Apple_family?page=1). This is **not** the separate, white-coated G1 mare named Gingerbread, described by [My Little Wiki](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Gingerbread).

## Important moments

1. **Helping raise the barn — “Apple Family Reunion” (S3E8).** After Applejack's disastrous hayride destroys the barn, Gingerbread appears among the workers during “Raise This Barn,” the collective repair that saves the reunion. The [verified official-channel full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7LwXctUyB0I) is available, but **the matching video timestamp could not be verified** (the character catalog places his shot at approximately 18:39 in the episode). This is his only verifiable character-specific scene; additional moments would be speculative.
